CustomField.label: Display: Expected Text
CustomField.description: Optional and display only. Plain text (not a formula) that replaces the Expected line the Framework writes on a Query, Formula, or Compare two queries check, including the auto-generated Expected line on a multi-row ("Every record passes") query check. On a Formula check it replaces the "Passes when" echo of the pass condition. An Apex check writes its own Expected value, so this field does not apply there. Supports {!rhcResult.expectedValue}, {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount}, and {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount} plus {!record.FieldName} tokens. Example: every contact has an email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Display only. Plain text (not a formula) for the "Expected" line. Tokens: {!rhcResult.expectedValue}, {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount}, {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount}, {!record.FieldName}.
